notes: Quantities are per ONE standard adult portion and the app scales them. {{300|ml}} in a step is scaled too. Steps are written for someone who doesn't cook much: start with a 'Get ready' step for the chopping, draining and slicing (salty or spicy things like halloumi and feta are prepped after the baby step), and say which pan, what heat, how long and what done looks like. Every ingredient has an amount except salt and pepper (to taste). Run tools/check_recipes.py after editing.

recipes.name: Red lentil & spinach dhal
recipes.blurb: Cheap, warming and properly filling with yoghurt and chapatis.

steps.t: Get ready: finely chop the onion, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Rinse the lentils in a sieve under the cold tap until the water runs clearer.
Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin and turmeric and stir for 1 minute, until it smells fragrant.

Add the lentils, the tomatoes and {{300|ml}} water. Bring to the boil, then turn down to a gentle simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils have broken down and it's thick. Add a splash of water if it starts to stick.
Spoon the baby's portion into a bowl now, before the chilli and salt, and stir a little spinach into the baby's bowl so it wilts in the heat.
Stir the rest of the spinach, the garam masala and the chilli flakes into the pan and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach wilts. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Warm the chapatis in a dry frying pan for about 30 seconds a side. Serve the dhal with the yoghurt and chapatis.

baby.smooth: Blend or mash until smooth and loosen with their usual milk. Serve with a little full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Keep it thick and let it cool to warm. Chapati or toast fingers to scoop with, plus a spoon of full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, with small pieces of chapati.

recipes.name: Black bean & sweet potato chilli
recipes.blurb: Smoky beans and sweet potato with rice, cheese and yoghurt.

steps.t: Get ready: peel the sweet potato and cut it into 1.5 cm cubes. Chop the onion and pepper and crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans. Rinse the rice in a sieve.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan with a lid over a medium heat. Add the onion, pepper and sweet potato and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until the onion is soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and oregano and stir for 1 minute.
Add the beans, the tomatoes and {{100|ml}} water. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook gently for 20 minutes, stirring once or twice, until a knife slides easily into the sweet potato.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in a pan of boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes until tender, then drain. Grate the cheddar.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Stir the chilli flakes into the rest and season with salt. Serve over the rice with the cheddar and a spoon of yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Mash the beans and sweet potato smooth with a little full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Lightly squashed beans, soft sweet potato cubes to pick up, sticky rice and a pinch of cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli, with a little cheese.

recipes.name: Tofu & broccoli peanut noodles
recipes.blurb: Crispy tofu, broccoli and noodles in a quick satay-style sauce. No coconut.

steps.t: Get ready: put the kettle on. Pat the tofu dry with kitchen paper and cut it into fingers. Cut the broccoli into small florets. Crush the garlic, grate the ginger and squeeze the lime juice.
Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the tofu for about 8 minutes, turning every couple of minutes, until golden on most sides.
Meanwhile, cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water following the packet, adding the broccoli and edamame for the last 3 minutes. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
In a bowl, whisk the peanut butter with the garlic, ginger, lime juice and a splash of the noodle water until smooth and pourable.
Take the baby's portion out now: tofu fingers, soft broccoli and short noodles with a little sauce, before the soy and chilli. Squash any edamame in the baby's portion flat with a fork.
Stir the soy sauce and chilli flakes into the rest of the sauce. Tip the noodles, veg and sauce into the tofu pan and toss over a low heat for 1 minute until everything is coated.

baby.smooth: Blend broccoli and a little tofu with a teaspoon of the peanut sauce and some water.
baby.finger: Tofu fingers, soft broccoli florets, squashed edamame and short noodles. If peanut is new to them, try it earlier in the day first.
baby.chopped: As yours before the soy and chilli, chopped small.

recipes.name: Lentil & mushroom bolognese
recipes.blurb: The family classic, with lentils and mushrooms instead of mince.

steps.t: Get ready: finely chop the onion, carrot and mushrooms (a food processor does it in seconds). Crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the lentils. Put a large pan of water on to boil for the pasta.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan or saucepan over a medium heat. Add the chopped veg and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and starting to brown.
Stir in the garlic, tomato purée and oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, the tomatoes and {{75|ml}} water. Simmer gently for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in the boiling water for the time on the packet. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain. Grate the cheese.
Take the baby's sauce and pasta out now, before the Henderson's and seasoning.
Season the rest of the sauce with Henderson's, salt and pepper. Toss it with the pasta, loosening with a splash of the pasta water, and scatter the cheese over.

baby.smooth: Blend the sauce with a few pieces of soft pasta.
baby.finger: Big pasta shapes like fusilli, cooked soft and coated in sauce, with a little grated cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours before seasoning, with the pasta cut small.

recipes.name: Paneer & pea curry
recipes.blurb: Mild tomato curry with golden paneer and peas. No cream or coconut.

steps.t: Get ready: cut the paneer into 2 cm cubes. Chop the onion, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Chop the coriander. Rinse the rice in a sieve.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the paneer for about 4 minutes, turning, until golden on a few sides. Lift it onto a plate.
Put the rice on: cook it in a pan of boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes until tender, then drain.
Turn the paneer pan down to a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, ground coriander and turmeric and stir for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and {{75|ml}} water and simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the peas and paneer and simmer for 3 minutes, then take the pan off the heat.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the yoghurt, garam masala, chilli and salt. Stir a spoon of full-fat plain yoghurt into the baby's portion if you like.
Stir the yoghurt into the rest off the heat (so it doesn't split).
Stir the garam masala and chilli flakes into the rest and season with salt. Scatter over the coriander and serve with the rice.

baby.smooth: Blend the sauce with the peas and a little paneer.
baby.finger: Paneer fingers, squashed peas, and rice they can grab in clumps.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, paneer chopped small.

recipes.name: Chickpea shakshuka with feta
recipes.blurb: Eggs baked in a smoky pepper and tomato sauce, with bread to dunk.

steps.t: Get ready: slice the onion and pepper into thin strips. Crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat the oil in a wide frying pan that has a lid, over a medium heat. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer, uncovered, for 8 minutes, until thick enough that a spoon drawn through it leaves a gap.

Spoon the baby's portion of sauce into a small pan, crack in one egg, cover and cook on a low heat for about 8 minutes, until the white and yolk are both fully set. Do the baby's egg before any salt, chilli or feta goes in.

Season the rest with salt and chilli flakes. Make a hollow for each egg with the back of a spoon and crack the eggs in. Cover and cook on a low heat for 5 to 8 minutes, until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft.
Meanwhile, toast the bread. Crumble the feta over the top and serve.

baby.smooth: Cook their egg until firm and mash it into blended sauce.
baby.finger: Their egg cooked until fully set, in strips, with squashed chickpeas and bread fingers to dip. No feta: it's salty.
baby.chopped: As yours, egg cooked through, no feta.

recipes.name: Smoky chickpea & halloumi traybake
recipes.blurb: One tray of roast veg, chickpeas and halloumi with tahini yoghurt.

steps.t: Get ready: heat the oven to 200°C fan. Cut the onion, courgette and pepper into chunks about 3 cm across. Drain and rinse the chickpeas[[ (keep a spoonful back for the baby)]] and pat them dry with kitchen paper.
On a large baking tray, toss the veg and chickpeas with the oil, smoked paprika and cumin, then spread them out in one layer. Roast for 20 minutes.
Take the baby's veg off the tray now, before the salt and halloumi. Warm the baby's spoonful of chickpeas in the microwave until hot and squash them flat.
Slice the halloumi about 1 cm thick. Season the tray with salt, add the halloumi and the whole cherry tomatoes, and roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the halloumi is golden.
Meanwhile, squeeze the lemon juice into the yoghurt, add the tahini and a splash of water, and stir until it's runny enough to drizzle.
Warm the flatbreads in the oven for the last 2 minutes. Serve the traybake with the tahini yoghurt and flatbreads.

baby.smooth: Mash the roast veg and chickpeas with full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Soft roast pepper and courgette strips, squashed chickpeas, flatbread fingers and full-fat plain yoghurt. No halloumi: it's very salty.
baby.chopped: As yours before the salt and halloumi, with the held-back chickpeas squashed and everything cut small.

recipes.name: Mushroom & lentil cottage pie
recipes.blurb: A weekend bake. Make a big one; it reheats brilliantly.

steps.t: Get ready: scrub the potatoes (no need to peel) and cut them into 3 cm chunks. Finely chop the onion, carrot and mushrooms. Drain and rinse the lentils. Grate the cheddar.
Put the potatoes in a saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil. Simmer for 15 to 18 minutes until a knife slides in easily. Heat the oven to 200°C fan.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Add the onion, carrot and mushrooms and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft.
Stir in the tomato purée and herbs for 1 minute, then add the lentils and {{100|ml}} water. Simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with the milk and butter until smooth.
Spoon some filling into a small ovenproof dish for the baby now and top it with mash, before the stock and seasoning.
Crumble the stock cube into the rest of the filling with the Henderson's, salt and pepper and stir well. Tip it into a baking dish, spread the mash over the top and scatter with the cheddar.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling, with the baby's dish alongside for the last 15. Meanwhile, cook the peas in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain and serve with the pie.

baby.smooth: Mash the filling and potato together until smooth.
baby.finger: Soft forkfuls of filling and mash, with squashed peas.
baby.chopped: As yours before the stock, with a little cheese.

recipes.name: Pesto pasta with Quorn & spinach
recipes.blurb: A ten-minute rescue dinner from the freezer and cupboard.

steps.t: Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the pasta and cook it for the time on the packet, adding the frozen Quorn pieces and peas for the last 5 minutes.
Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain everything and return it to the pan. Stir the spinach through until it wilts.
Take the baby's portion out now, with only a little pesto (it's salty and contains nuts).
Stir the pesto and a splash of the pasta water through the rest until it's glossy.

baby.smooth: Blend pasta, peas and spinach with a little water and a tiny bit of pesto.
baby.finger: Big pasta shapes, Quorn cut into small strips, squashed peas. If tree nuts are new to them, try pesto earlier in the day first.
baby.chopped: As yours with the Quorn chopped small and only a little pesto.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with peas & edamame
recipes.blurb: Microwave rice, frozen veg and eggs. On the table in 12 minutes.

steps.t: Get ready: crush the garlic. Beat the eggs in a mug. Squeeze the rice pouches to break the grains up.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan or wok over a high heat. Fry the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the frozen peas and edamame and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes until piping hot.
Push the rice to one side, pour the eggs into the gap and stir for about 1 minute until scrambled and set, then mix them through the rice.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the soy sauce. Squash any edamame and peas in the baby's portion flat with a fork.
Season the rest with the soy sauce, tossing well.

baby.smooth: Blend rice, peas and egg with a little water.
baby.finger: Clumps of rice, strips of well-cooked egg, squashed peas and edamame.
baby.chopped: As yours, before the soy sauce.

recipes.name: Cheesy beans on toast with an egg
recipes.blurb: The classic emergency dinner, with enough protein to count.

steps.t: Get ready: grate the cheddar.
Warm the beans in a small saucepan over a low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring now and then.

Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat, crack in the eggs and fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set[[ (fry the baby's a little longer, turning it, until the yolk is firm)]]. Toast the bread and butter it.
Take the baby's portion out now: toast fingers, a spoon of mashed beans and an egg cooked until the yolk is firm.
Pile the beans on the toast, scatter the cheese over and top with the eggs.

baby.smooth: Mash a few beans with egg cooked until the yolk is completely firm.
baby.finger: Toast fingers, a small spoon of mashed reduced-salt beans, and egg cooked through, in strips. Go easy on the cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours, cut small, with a little cheese.

recipes.name: 15-minute chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.blurb: Tins, frozen spinach and the spice rack. No curry paste, so no hidden coconut.

steps.t: Get ready: crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over a medium heat. Add the garlic, cumin and turmeric and stir for 1 minute, without letting the garlic brown.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and frozen spinach. Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring, and squash some of the chickpeas with the back of a spoon to thicken it.
Meanwhile, heat the rice pouch in the microwave following the packet.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the garam masala, chilli and salt.
Stir the garam masala and chilli flakes into the rest and season with salt. Serve with the rice and a spoon of yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Blend with a spoon of full-fat plain yoghurt until smooth.
baby.finger: Squashed chickpeas and spinach to scoop with rice, plus full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.chopped: As yours, before the chilli and salt.

recipes.name: Bean & cheese quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Crisp wraps with smoky beans and melted cheese. Great for little hands.

steps.t: Get ready: drain and rinse the beans. Grate the cheddar.
In a bowl, mash the beans with a fork, along with the smoked paprika and cumin, until mostly smooth.
Make the baby's quesadilla first: spread a thin layer of beans and a little cheese over half a wrap and fold it over, no chilli.
Stir the chilli flakes into the rest of the beans. Spread them over half of each wrap, scatter the cheese on top and fold the wraps over.
Heat a dry frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the quesadillas, the baby's first, for 2 minutes a side until crisp and the cheese has melted. Cut into wedges and serve with the yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Mash the beans with full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Quesadilla cut into strips once cooled, with full-fat plain yoghurt to dip.
baby.chopped: Small wedges of yours without the chilli.

recipes.name: Chana masala with naan
recipes.blurb: A proper tomatoey chickpea curry with cool garlic yoghurt.

steps.t: Get ready: chop the onion. Crush most of the garlic and finely grate the rest for the yoghurt. Grate the ginger. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Chop the coriander.
Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes until soft and golden at the edges.
Add the crushed garlic, ginger, cumin, ground coriander and turmeric and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and {{100|ml}} water. Simmer for 15 minutes, squashing a few chickpeas against the side of the pan to thicken it.
Spoon the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Stir the garam masala and chilli flakes into the rest and season with salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Mix the grated garlic into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt. Warm the naan in a dry frying pan or the toaster. Serve the curry with the garlic yoghurt, coriander and naan.

baby.smooth: Blend with a spoon of full-fat plain yoghurt until smooth.
baby.finger: Squash the chickpeas with a fork so they're soft and flat. Strips of naan to dip.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, chickpeas squashed, with naan pieces.

recipes.name: Potato, cauliflower & chickpea curry
recipes.blurb: Aloo gobi made into a full dinner. Everything goes in one pan.

steps.t: Get ready: slice the onion, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Cut the potato into 2 cm cubes (no need to peel) and the cauliflower into small florets. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Chop the coriander.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan with a lid over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softening.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric and ground coriander and stir for 1 minute.

Add the potato, cauliflower, chickpeas, tomatoes and {{150|ml}} water and stir. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on a low heat for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potato is tender. Add a splash of water if it starts to stick.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Stir the garam masala and chilli flakes into the rest, season with salt and scatter with the coriander.
Warm the chapatis in a dry frying pan for about 30 seconds a side. Serve with the yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Blend with a little full-fat plain yoghurt until smooth.
baby.finger: Soft potato and cauliflower pieces and squashed chickpeas, with chapati fingers.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, cut small.

recipes.name: Saag paneer
recipes.blurb: Golden paneer in a silky spiced spinach sauce. The blender does the work.

steps.t: Get ready: cut the paneer into 2 cm cubes. Chop the onion, crush the garlic and grate the ginger.
Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the paneer for about 5 minutes, turning, until golden on a few sides. Tip it onto a plate.
Turn the heat down to medium, add the rest of the oil and the onion, and cook for 6 minutes until soft.

Add the garlic, ginger, cumin and ground coriander and stir for 1 minute. Add the frozen spinach and a splash of water, cover and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until it has thawed and is hot.
Take the pan off the heat and blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in a blender), adding water to loosen it to a thick sauce.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Return the rest to the pan with the paneer, garam masala and chilli flakes and simmer for 3 minutes. Take off the heat, stir in half the yoghurt and season with salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Warm the chapatis in a dry frying pan for about 30 seconds a side. Serve with the rest of the yoghurt.

baby.smooth: The blended spinach is perfect as it is, loosened with a little full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Paneer cut into fingers, plus spinach sauce to dip chapati into.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, paneer cut small.

recipes.name: Lemon ricotta pasta with peas & broccoli
recipes.blurb: Bright, creamy and green. Dinner in the time it takes the pasta to boil.

steps.t: Get ready: put a large pan of water on to boil. Cut the broccoli into small florets. Finely grate the garlic, the cheese and the lemon zest, then cut the lemon in half for squeezing.
Cook the pasta in the boiling water for the time on the packet, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes and the peas for the last 2.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, mix the ricotta with the garlic, most of the cheese and the lemon zest[[, keeping a spoonful of plain ricotta back for the baby first]].
Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
Take the baby's portion out now and toss it with the baby's plain ricotta and a splash of the water, before the chilli.
Toss the rest in the bowl with the ricotta mix, the oil and enough pasta water to make it creamy. Finish with a squeeze of lemon, the chilli flakes, black pepper and the rest of the cheese.

baby.smooth: Blend the pasta, veg and ricotta with a little of the water.
baby.finger: Pasta shapes and broccoli florets, ricotta-coated.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli, chopped small.

recipes.name: Chickpea puttanesca
recipes.blurb: Olives, capers and garlic in a punchy tomato sauce, with chickpeas for protein.

steps.t: Get ready: put a large pan of water on to boil. Thinly slice the garlic. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Halve the olives. Grate the cheese.
Cook the pasta in the boiling water for the time on the packet.

Meanwhile, heat the oil in a frying pan over a low heat and gently fry the garlic for 1 minute, without letting it brown. Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Take the baby's portion of sauce out now, before the olives, capers and chilli.

Stir the olives, capers and chilli flakes into the rest and simmer for 2 minutes. Scoop out a mugful of pasta water, drain the pasta and toss it with the sauce and a splash of the water. Finish with the cheese.

baby.smooth: Blend the plain sauce and some pasta until smooth.
baby.finger: Pasta shapes in the plain sauce, chickpeas squashed.
baby.chopped: Plain sauce and pasta, chickpeas squashed.

recipes.name: Roasted pepper pasta with feta
recipes.blurb: A creamy blended sauce of red peppers and white beans, with salty feta on top.

steps.t: Get ready: put a large pan of water on to boil. Drain the roasted peppers. Drain and rinse the beans. Peel the garlic.
Cook the pasta in the boiling water for the time on the packet.
Meanwhile, blend the peppers, beans, garlic, smoked paprika, oil and {{80|ml}} water until smooth. Pour into a large frying pan and warm over a low heat for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain the pasta and add it to the sauce with the spinach. Toss for 1 minute until the spinach wilts, loosening with a splash of pasta water.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the feta and chilli.
Season the rest with salt and pepper, crumble the feta over the top and add the chilli flakes.

baby.smooth: Blend a little more with water until smooth.
baby.finger: Pasta shapes coated in the sauce.
baby.chopped: As yours before the feta, chopped small.

recipes.name: Creamy spinach & white bean gnocchi
recipes.blurb: Pan-fried gnocchi in a lemony ricotta, spinach and bean sauce.

steps.t: Get ready: crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans. Grate the cheese. Cut the lemon in half for squeezing.
Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the gnocchi straight from the packet (no need to boil them) and fry for about 8 minutes, turning, until golden in places.
Turn the heat down to medium. Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the beans, spinach and {{60|ml}} water. Stir for 2 minutes until the spinach wilts, then stir in the ricotta and most of the cheese.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Season the rest with a squeeze of lemon, salt, pepper and the chilli flakes, and finish with the last of the cheese.

baby.smooth: Blend with a little water until smooth.
baby.finger: Gnocchi halved lengthways, with the beans squashed.
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, gnocchi cut small.

recipes.name: Sweet potato & black bean burritos
recipes.blurb: Air-fried sweet potato, smoky beans, cheese and salsa, all rolled up.

steps.t: Get ready: cut the sweet potato into 2 cm cubes (no need to peel). Drain and rinse the beans. Grate the cheddar. Cut the lime into wedges.
Toss the sweet potato with the oil, cumin and smoked paprika. Air fry at 200°C for 18 minutes, shaking halfway, until soft and browned (or roast on a tray at 220°C for 25 minutes).
Meanwhile, warm the beans in a small saucepan over a low heat with a splash of water for 5 minutes, squashing about half of them with a fork.
Take the baby's share of sweet potato and beans out now, before the chilli and salt.
Season the rest with the chilli flakes, salt and a squeeze of lime. Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for about 20 seconds a side.
Fill each tortilla down the middle with beans, sweet potato, cheese, salsa and yoghurt, fold in the sides and roll up.

baby.smooth: Blend the sweet potato and beans with a little full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Sweet potato cubes, squashed beans and strips of tortilla.
baby.chopped: Sweet potato, beans and grated cheese, cut small.

recipes.name: Black bean & sweetcorn enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Rolled, sauced and baked under bubbling cheese. Ten minutes of work.

steps.t: Get ready: heat the oven to 200°C. Chop the pepper and crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans. Grate the cheddar. Mix the passata with the oregano.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Add the pepper and cook for 4 minutes until softening, then add the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the beans and sweetcorn and warm through for 2 minutes, squashing some of the beans with a fork.

Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt: roll a little filling in a piece of tortilla and lay it in a small ovenproof dish with a spoon of passata and a little cheese for the baby.

Season the rest of the filling with the chilli flakes and salt. Spoon it down the middle of each tortilla, roll them up and lay them seam-down in a baking dish. Pour over the passata and scatter with the cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling, with the baby's dish alongside for the last 10. Serve with the yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Blend the filling with the passata.
baby.finger: A tortilla rolled round some filling, baked with a little cheese, cut into strips.
baby.chopped: Cut up from a mini baked one.

recipes.name: Air-fryer halloumi fajitas
recipes.blurb: Charred peppers and squeaky halloumi with salsa and yoghurt.

steps.t: Get ready: slice the pepper and onion into thin strips. Cut the lime into wedges.
Toss the pepper and onion with the oil, cumin and smoked paprika. Air fry at 200°C for 8 minutes.
Take a few soft pepper strips out for the baby now, before the halloumi and chilli.
Cut the halloumi into fingers. Add it to the air fryer with the chilli flakes, toss, and air fry for 8 more minutes, shaking once, until the halloumi is golden.
Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for about 20 seconds a side. Squeeze the lime over the filling and serve in the tortillas with the salsa and yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Blend the peppers with full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Soft pepper strips and tortilla strips spread with full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.chopped: Peppers and tortilla cut small, with full-fat plain yoghurt.

recipes.name: Smoky tofu tacos with lime slaw
recipes.blurb: Crisp smoky tofu, crunchy slaw and a soft tortilla.

steps.t: Get ready: pat the tofu dry with kitchen paper. Grate the garlic. Finely shred the cabbage and grate the carrot. Squeeze the lime juice.
Tear the tofu into bite-sized chunks and toss in a bowl with the oil, cornflour, smoked paprika, cumin and garlic until coated. Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, make the slaw: mix the cabbage and carrot with half the yoghurt and the lime juice.
Take the baby's tofu out now, before the chilli and salt.
Toss the rest of the tofu with the chilli flakes and a pinch of salt. Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for about 20 seconds a side, then fill with the tofu, slaw and the rest of the yoghurt.

baby.smooth: Blend the tofu with full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Soft pieces of tofu (pick the least crispy), grated carrot and tortilla strips.
baby.chopped: Tofu and tortilla cut small, a little grated carrot.

recipes.name: Huevos rancheros
recipes.blurb: Eggs baked in smoky tomatoes and beans with crisp tortillas.

steps.t: Get ready: chop the onion and pepper. Drain and rinse the beans. Grate the cheddar. Slice the avocado and cut the lime into wedges.
Heat the oil in a frying pan that has a lid, over a medium heat. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the cumin and smoked paprika for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and beans. Simmer for 8 minutes until thick.

Spoon the baby's portion of sauce into a small pan, crack in one egg, cover and cook on a low heat for about 8 minutes, until the baby's egg is set right through, white and yolk. Do the baby's before the chilli and salt.
Season the rest with salt. Make a dip for each egg with the back of a spoon and crack the eggs in. Cover and cook on a low heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set.
Meanwhile, toast the tortillas in a dry frying pan for 1 minute a side. Serve the eggs and sauce on the tortillas, topped with the cheese, avocado, a squeeze of lime and the chilli flakes.

baby.smooth: Blend the sauce with mashed avocado.
baby.finger: Toasted tortilla strips to dip, avocado fingers, and egg cooked until the yolk is completely firm.
baby.chopped: Sauce, a fully set egg and avocado, chopped.

recipes.name: Veg chow mein with egg
recipes.blurb: Takeaway-style noodles in 20 minutes, with plenty of egg.

steps.t: Get ready: finely shred the cabbage, cut the carrot into matchsticks and slice the spring onions. Crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Beat the eggs in a mug.
Cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water following the packet. Drain and rinse under the cold tap so they don't stick together.
Heat half the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat until very hot. Add the eggs and stir for about 1 minute until just set, then tip them onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the cabbage, carrot, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and egg and toss for 2 minutes until hot.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the beansprouts, soy and chilli.

Add the beansprouts and stir-fry for 2 minutes until they're piping hot all the way through. Toss with the soy sauce and most of the spring onions, then finish with the sesame seeds, the rest of the spring onions and the chilli flakes.

baby.smooth: Blend the egg, noodles and veg with a little water.
baby.finger: Noodles cut short, egg pieces and soft carrot.
baby.chopped: As yours before the soy, noodles cut short.

recipes.name: Sticky sesame tofu with broccoli & rice
recipes.blurb: Crisp tofu in a sticky sweet chilli glaze. A Friday-night favourite.

steps.t: Get ready: rinse the rice in a sieve. Pat the tofu dry with kitchen paper and cut it into 2 cm cubes. Cut the broccoli into florets. Grate the garlic and ginger. Slice the spring onion.
Put the rice on: cook it in a pan of boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes until tender, then drain.
Toss the tofu with the oil and cornflour. Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, boil the broccoli and edamame in a pan of water for 4 minutes, then drain.
Take the baby's tofu, rice and broccoli out now, before the soy and sweet chilli. Squash any edamame in the baby's portion flat with a fork.

In a frying pan over a medium heat, bubble the soy sauce, sweet chilli sauce, garlic, ginger and {{1|tbsp}} water for 1 minute until slightly sticky. Toss the tofu through. Serve on the rice with the greens, sesame seeds and spring onion.

baby.smooth: Blend the tofu, broccoli and rice with water.
baby.finger: Plain tofu fingers, broccoli florets and squashed rice balls.
baby.chopped: Plain tofu, rice and broccoli, chopped small.

recipes.name: Gnocchi traybake with mozzarella
recipes.blurb: Crisp gnocchi, roasted peppers and tomatoes, and melting mozzarella. One tray.

steps.t: Get ready: heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the pepper and onion into chunks. Peel the garlic and squash each clove with the flat of a knife. Drain and rinse the beans.
On a large baking tray, toss the gnocchi (straight from the packet), pepper, onion, whole cherry tomatoes, beans and garlic with the oil and oregano. Spread out in one layer.
Roast for 20 minutes, shaking the tray halfway, until the gnocchi are golden.
Take the baby's portion off the tray now, before the salt.
Tear the mozzarella over the rest, season with salt and pepper, and roast for 5 more minutes until it melts.

baby.smooth: Blend the veg and beans with a little water.
baby.finger: Gnocchi halved, soft pepper strips and squashed tomatoes, and a little torn mozzarella.
baby.chopped: As yours, cut small.

recipes.name: Tandoori paneer traybake
recipes.blurb: Yoghurt-spiced paneer and veg roasted hot, with cucumber raita.

steps.t: Get ready: heat the oven to 220°C and line a large tray with baking paper. Cut the paneer into 2 cm cubes, the cauliflower into small florets and the onion and pepper into chunks. Grate the garlic and ginger.
In a large bowl, mix half the yoghurt with the garlic, ginger, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, smoked paprika and oil.
Add the paneer and veg and toss until coated, then spread out on the tray. Roast for 25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Take the baby's portion off the tray now, before the chilli and salt.
Season the rest with the chilli flakes, salt and a squeeze of lemon. Grate the cucumber into the rest of the yoghurt to make raita.
Warm the naan in the oven for 2 minutes. Serve the traybake with the raita and naan.

baby.smooth: Blend the veg with full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Paneer fingers, soft cauliflower and naan strips, with full-fat plain yoghurt to dip.
baby.chopped: As yours, cut small.

recipes.name: Spinach, feta & cottage cheese filo pie
recipes.blurb: A crisp, flaky pie with a high-protein filling. Takes 15 minutes to assemble.

steps.t: Get ready: heat the oven to 190°C and oil a small baking dish. Thaw the spinach in a bowl in the microwave for 3 to 4 minutes, let it cool a little, then squeeze it really dry in a clean tea towel. Slice the spring onions and beat the egg.
In a bowl, mix the spinach with the cottage cheese, egg, spring onions and plenty of black pepper.
Spoon the baby's share of the filling into a small ramekin now, before the feta goes in.
Crumble the feta into the rest. Lay half the filo sheets in the dish, brushing each one with oil. Spoon in the filling, scrunch the rest of the filo on top and brush with oil.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden and crisp, with the ramekin alongside for the last 20. Serve with the salad.

baby.smooth: Blend the baby's baked filling until smooth.
baby.finger: Fingers of the set ramekin filling, plus a little flaky pastry.
baby.chopped: The ramekin filling and some pastry, cut small.

recipes.name: Cheesy bean & broccoli pasta bake
recipes.blurb: A smoky tomato pasta bake packed with two kinds of beans.

steps.t: Get ready: heat the oven to 200°C. Put a large pan of water on to boil. Cut the broccoli into small florets and crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans. Grate the cheddar.
Cook the pasta for 3 minutes less than the packet says (it finishes in the oven), adding the broccoli for the last 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the passata, oregano, smoked paprika and beans. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain the pasta and broccoli and stir them into the sauce.
Spoon the baby's portion into a ramekin now, before the salt.
Season the rest and tip it into a baking dish. Scatter the cheese over both and bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

baby.smooth: Blend with a little water.
baby.finger: Pasta shapes and broccoli florets, beans squashed.
baby.chopped: As yours, cut small.

recipes.name: Microwave jacket potato, beans & cheese
recipes.blurb: A jacket potato in 15 minutes, loaded with protein.

steps.t: Get ready: scrub the potato and prick it all over with a fork. Grate the cheddar.

Microwave the potato on full power for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, until soft all the way through when squeezed (use an oven glove). Add 4 to 5 minutes for each extra potato. For crisp skin, air fry at 200°C for 5 minutes afterwards.
Meanwhile, warm the beans in a small saucepan over a low heat for 4 to 5 minutes.
Take the baby's portion out now: potato flesh, a few beans and a little cheese.
Split the potato, add the butter, then pile on the beans, cheese and cottage cheese. Add black pepper and serve with the salad.

baby.smooth: Mash the potato with butter and their usual milk.
baby.finger: Potato wedges once cool, and a few beans squashed.
baby.chopped: Potato, beans and cheese, cut small.

recipes.name: Tomato & red lentil soup with cheese toasties
recipes.blurb: Thick, smooth soup with a toastie to dunk in it.

steps.t: Get ready: chop the onion and carrot and crush the garlic. Rinse the lentils in a sieve. Grate the cheddar.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and carrot and cook for 6 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and smoked paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, the tomatoes and {{400|ml}} water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils have broken down.
Take the pan off the heat and blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in a blender, no more than half full, holding the lid down with a tea towel).
Take the baby's portion out now, before the stock goes in.
Crumble the stock cube into the rest, simmer for 2 minutes and add pepper.
For the toasties, butter the outside of the bread and sandwich the cheese between. Cook in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and melted.

baby.smooth: Perfect as it is, served lukewarm.
baby.finger: Thick soup to dip toast fingers into, plus a little toastie cut into strips.
baby.chopped: Soup thickened a little, with toastie pieces.

recipes.name: Big bean minestrone
recipes.blurb: A hearty Italian veg soup thick with beans and pasta.

steps.t: Get ready: chop the onion and crush the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans. Grate the cheese.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and herbs and stir for 1 minute.
Add the frozen veg, the tomatoes, the beans and {{450|ml}} water and bring to the boil.
Add the pasta and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender. Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the stock and salt.
Crumble the stock cube into the rest and simmer for 2 minutes. Season, then serve with the cheese and bread.

baby.smooth: Blend with a spoon of grated cheese.
baby.finger: Drain some of the bits out: pasta, beans and soft veg, with a little cheese.
baby.chopped: As yours before the stock, cut small.

recipes.name: Chickpea & apricot stew with couscous
recipes.blurb: A gently sweet, cinnamon-spiced North African-style stew.

steps.t: Get ready: chop the onion and crush the garlic. Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 2 cm cubes. Chop the apricots. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Chop the coriander and cut the lemon into wedges.
Heat the oil in a large saucepan with a lid over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, cumin, cinnamon and ground ginger and stir for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, chickpeas, tomatoes, apricots and {{200|ml}} water. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook gently for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender. Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Season the rest with the chilli flakes and salt.

Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over {{75|ml}} boiling water, cover with a plate and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Serve the stew on the couscous with the yoghurt, a squeeze of lemon and the coriander.

baby.smooth: Blend with a little full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Sweet potato pieces, squashed chickpeas and couscous pressed into small balls.
baby.chopped: As yours, cut small.

recipes.name: Baked pea & spinach risotto
recipes.blurb: Creamy risotto without the stirring. It goes in the oven.

steps.t: Get ready: heat the oven to 200°C and put the kettle on. Chop the onion and crush the garlic. Grate the cheese and zest the lemon.
In an ovenproof pan with a lid (or a casserole dish), melt the butter over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and rice and stir for 1 minute until the rice is coated.
Pour in {{250|ml}} boiling water, stir, cover and bake for 18 minutes.
Stir in the frozen peas, edamame and spinach (they add a little water as they thaw), cover again and bake for 5 more minutes.
Spoon the baby's portion out now, before the stock and cheese. Squash any edamame and peas in the baby's portion flat with a fork.
Dissolve the stock cube in {{30|ml}} boiling water and stir it through the rest with most of the cheese, until creamy. Top with the ricotta, the rest of the cheese, the lemon zest and black pepper.

baby.smooth: Blend with a spoon of ricotta.
baby.finger: Squeeze into small soft balls, with peas squashed.
baby.chopped: As yours before the stock, with a little ricotta.

recipes.name: Egg & veg biryani
recipes.blurb: Fragrant spiced rice with jammy eggs and raita. One pot.

steps.t: Get ready: put the kettle on. Thinly slice the onion, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clearer. Chop the coriander.
Lower the eggs into a small pan of boiling water and boil for 8 minutes. Cool them in cold water, then peel.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a saucepan with a tight-fitting lid over a medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric and garam masala and stir for 1 minute. Add the rice, the frozen veg and {{160|ml}} boiling water and stir once.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes without lifting the lid. Take off the heat and leave it covered for 5 more minutes.
Take the baby's portion out now, before the chilli and salt.
Season the rest with the chilli flakes and salt and fluff it up with a fork. Grate the cucumber into the yoghurt to make raita. Serve with the halved eggs and coriander.

baby.smooth: Blend the rice and veg with a little full-fat plain yoghurt and egg.
baby.finger: Squashed rice balls, soft veg and egg quarters (fully set).
baby.chopped: As yours before the chilli and salt, with chopped egg.

recipes.name: Greek chickpea couscous bowls
recipes.blurb: Crispy chickpeas, crunchy salad, feta and houmous on lemony couscous.

steps.t: Get ready: put the kettle on. Drain and rinse the chickpeas[[, keep a spoonful back for the baby,]] and pat them dry with kitchen paper. Chop the cucumber[[ (keep a few sticks back for the baby)]], halve the tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion. Squeeze the lemon juice.
Toss the chickpeas with half the oil, the oregano and smoked paprika. Air fry at 200°C for 12 minutes, shaking once, until crisp.
Meanwhile, put the couscous in a bowl, pour over {{75|ml}} boiling water, cover with a plate and leave for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork, stirring in the rest of the oil and the lemon juice.
Warm the baby's spoonful of chickpeas in the microwave until hot, then squash them flat. Take the baby's couscous and cucumber sticks out now too, before the feta and olives.
Build the bowls: couscous, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion and chickpeas, with the feta crumbled over, the olives and a spoon of houmous.

baby.smooth: Blend the couscous and chickpeas with houmous and water.
baby.finger: Couscous pressed into balls, squashed chickpeas, and peeled cucumber sticks.
baby.chopped: Couscous, squashed chickpeas and chopped cucumber.

recipes.name: 15-minute halloumi & chickpea couscous
recipes.blurb: Golden halloumi, warm chickpeas and tomatoes on lemony couscous.

steps.t: Get ready: put the kettle on. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Squeeze the lemon juice.
Put the couscous and herbs in a bowl, pour over {{75|ml}} boiling water, cover with a plate and leave for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat half the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Add the chickpeas and tomatoes and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until the tomatoes soften. Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute until it wilts. Tip into a bowl.
Take the baby's portion (with some couscous) out now, before the halloumi.
Slice the halloumi about 1 cm thick. Wipe the pan, heat the rest of the oil over a medium-high heat and fry the halloumi for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden.
Fluff the couscous with a fork, stir in the lemon juice, black pepper and the chickpea mix, and top with the halloumi.

baby.smooth: Blend the couscous, chickpeas and tomatoes with water.
baby.finger: Couscous balls, squashed chickpeas and soft tomatoes.
baby.chopped: As yours before the halloumi, chopped.

recipes.name: Naan pizzas
recipes.blurb: Pizza night with no dough. Ready in 10 minutes in the air fryer or oven.

steps.t: Get ready: heat the air fryer to 190°C (or the oven to 220°C). Thinly slice the pepper and mushrooms. Tear the mozzarella and grate the cheddar.
Spread the naans with the passata and sprinkle with the oregano.
Make the baby's pizza now: a piece of naan with passata, a little mozzarella and some sweetcorn, before the olives and chilli.
Top the rest with the mozzarella, cheddar, pepper, mushrooms, sweetcorn and olives.
Air fry for 6 to 8 minutes (or bake for 10 minutes) until bubbling, with the baby's piece alongside. Add the chilli flakes and serve with the salad.

baby.smooth: Blend the sauce with a little sweetcorn and cheese.
baby.finger: Pizza fingers from the baby's piece, cooled.
baby.chopped: The baby's pizza, cut small.

recipes.name: Halloumi burgers with air-fryer wedges
recipes.blurb: Halloumi, roasted pepper and smoky yoghurt sauce in a bun, with crisp wedges.

steps.t: Get ready: cut the potatoes into wedges (no need to peel). Grate the garlic. Thinly slice the red onion.
Toss the wedges with the oil and half the smoked paprika. Air fry at 200°C for 20 to 22 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden outside and soft inside.
Take a few wedges out for the baby now, before the salt and halloumi.
Slice the halloumi about 1 cm thick. Heat a dry frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the halloumi for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden.
Meanwhile, mix the yoghurt with the garlic and the rest of the paprika. Sprinkle the wedges with salt.
Build the burgers: bun, garlic yoghurt, salad, halloumi, roasted peppers and red onion. Serve with the wedges.

baby.smooth: Mash the potato with full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Potato wedges, a strip of roasted pepper and toast-like bun fingers.
baby.chopped: Wedges and pepper, cut small, with full-fat plain yoghurt.

recipes.name: Black bean burgers with sweet potato fries
recipes.blurb: Smoky bean burgers blitzed in a processor, with crisp fries.

steps.t: Get ready: cut the sweet potato into fries about 1 cm thick. Drain the beans and pat them really dry with kitchen paper. Crush the garlic.
Toss the fries with half the oil. Air fry at 200°C for 15 to 18 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, blitz the oats to a coarse flour in a food processor. Add the beans, garlic, cumin and smoked paprika and pulse until it holds together but still has some texture.
Shape a small patty for the baby now, before the chilli and salt.
Add the chilli flakes and a pinch of salt to the rest and shape into burgers. Chill all the burgers in the fridge for 10 minutes so they firm up.

Heat the rest of the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the burgers for 4 minutes a side, laying the cheese on top for the last minute. Serve in the buns with the yoghurt and salad.

baby.smooth: Mash the patty and sweet potato with full-fat plain yoghurt.
baby.finger: Patty cut into fingers, plus soft fries.
baby.chopped: Patty and fries cut small.

recipes.name: Salt & pepper tofu
recipes.blurb: The takeaway classic: crisp tofu with peppers, onion and spring onion.

steps.t: Get ready: rinse the rice in a sieve. Pat the tofu dry with kitchen paper and cut it into 2 cm cubes. Slice the pepper, onion and spring onions. Crush the garlic.
Put the rice on: cook it in a pan of boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes, adding the edamame for the last 3, then drain.
Toss the tofu with half the oil and the cornflour. Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, heat the rest of the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Stir-fry the pepper and onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic and ground ginger for 1 minute.
Take the baby's tofu, veg and rice out now, before the salt, pepper and chilli. Squash any edamame in the baby's portion flat with a fork.
Add the tofu to the pan with a big pinch of salt, lots of black pepper, the chilli flakes and the spring onions, and toss for 1 minute. Serve with the rice and edamame.

baby.smooth: Blend the tofu, peppers and rice with water.
baby.finger: Tofu fingers, soft pepper strips and rice balls.
baby.chopped: As yours before the seasoning, chopped.

recipes.name: Potato, spinach & feta frittata
recipes.blurb: A thick frittata with a salad. Good the next day too.

steps.t: Get ready: slice the potato thinly, about 3 mm (no need to peel). Slice the spring onion. Beat the eggs with some black pepper.
Heat the oil in a medium non-stick, ovenproof frying pan over a medium heat. Add the potato, cover with a lid or plate, and cook for 10 minutes, turning now and then, until tender.
Add the spinach and spring onion and stir for 1 minute until the spinach wilts. Spread everything out evenly.
Pour the eggs over and cook on a low heat for 6 minutes until the edges are set. Meanwhile, heat the grill to high.
Pick one corner to be the baby's piece: no feta goes on the baby's corner.
Scatter the feta over the top[[, leaving the baby's corner bare]].
Grill for 4 to 5 minutes until set and golden. Rest for 2 minutes, then cut into wedges. Toast the sourdough and serve with the salad.

baby.smooth: Blend the feta-free piece with a little milk.
baby.finger: Fingers of the feta-free piece, completely set.
baby.chopped: The feta-free piece, chopped.

recipes.name: Falafel & halloumi wraps
recipes.blurb: Shop falafel and halloumi in warm wraps with houmous. Ready in 12 minutes.

steps.t: Get ready: cut the cucumber into sticks and the lemon into wedges.
Air fry the falafel at 190°C for 8 minutes (or follow the pack).
Take a falafel, some cucumber sticks and a tortilla spread with houmous out for the baby now, before the halloumi.
Slice the halloumi about 1 cm thick. Heat a dry frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry it for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden.
Warm the tortillas in the same pan for about 20 seconds a side. Fill with houmous, salad, cucumber, falafel and halloumi, then add the yoghurt and a squeeze of lemon.

baby.smooth: Blend a falafel with houmous and water.
baby.finger: Falafel cut into fingers, cucumber sticks and tortilla strips with houmous.
baby.chopped: Falafel, tortilla and cucumber, chopped.
